coverage.scope: Working source-label inventory and editorial topic map for Odisha caste and community histories. Source-listed groups are not automatically distinct castes or equivalent communities.
limits: Administrative lists serve different purposes and are not a complete social history.
Names and legal categories may change; this index is not eligibility guidance.
Historical labels may be externally assigned; self-identification and regional scope require research.

ST,SC,centralOBC not comprehensively row-extracted in this bounded task.
No exhaustive all-Odisha caste count; no present-day legal classification opinion.
Current residents/community self-identification and origin traditions require source-specific research.

sources.title: Project Odisha · Paika: service, community and Odia heritage
sources.scope: Existing published article and its mapped historical references; seed relationships only.
limits: Secondary project synthesis; not independent corroboration of its cited primary research.
No complete community enumeration or legal classification.

sources.title: Odisha department: List of Communities
sources.scope: Inventory of four current download links on the departmental page
limits: Landing page links administrative lists, not an exhaustive census of Odisha community identities.

sources.title: List of Scheduled Tribes (department-linked PDF)
sources.scope: Two-page linked PDF; header and numbered entries1–64 inspected through original PDF extraction; only selected source observation retained
limits: Header cites Act6 of2024 dated15.02.2024 and state notification2232 dated20.02.2024; this is stated amendment context, not independent present-day legal validation.

No legal entitlement determination or automatic alias equivalence.

sources.title: List of Scheduled Castes (department-linked PDF)
sources.scope: Three-page linked PDF; header and serials1–95 inspected, including deleted entries; selected observations retained
limits: Header cites Act6 of2024 dated15.02.2024 and notification2232 dated20.02.2024; later changes not independently audited.
Numbered rows include deletion notices, not95 currently listed communities.
District restrictions and amendment text must accompany labels; no entitlement determination.

sources.title: List of SEBC as per Notification of Government of Odisha (19January2024 filename)
sources.scope: All216 numbered rows extracted with page-continuation segments and verbatim adjacent qualification cells from20-page original PDF

sources.title: Odisha OBC List (Central), department-linked PDF
sources.scope: Six-page original linkedPDF, serials1–200 including Nil/deletion rows; selected Paiko/Chasa source observations retained
limits: 2021-09 is upload-path component, not verified edition date. Rows include individual central notifications, including a2017deletion.
Current NCBC amendments and legal eligibility not independently audited.
StateSEBC and centralOBC are separate source inventories; do not equate their row numbers or grouped labels.
200 serial numbers include Nil/deleted slots; not200 unique communities.

sources.title: Odisha District Gazetteers: Bhadrak
sources.scope: Regional historical account of scribal work, not an administrative inventory
limits: Compiled2015–16 context; exact publication imprint not resolved here.
The text reproduces hierarchical caste classifications and essentialist praise. Do not adopt either.
Its phrase originally scribes is a summary, not documentary proof of a single caste-creation event.

sources.title: M.H. Kalavathy, Ethnical and Socio-Cultural Background of Marine Fishing Communities in Orissa, in U. Tietze (ed.), Artisanal Marine Fisherfolk of Orissa
sources.scope: 1985 regional occupational and community study; not complete community census
limits: No exact fieldwork dates verified; use study published1985, never survey2004.
2004 is FAO website copyright, not original publication.
Chapter draws partly on older ethnography and should be described as a period study, not present-day demographic truth.
Do not import caste-rank or enterprising-character praise, surname lists as identity tests, or universal gender-role prescriptions.
Do not transfer southern Telugu communities' festivals in section3.3 to Kaibarta.
